question: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju launched UMEED Central Portal to modernize Waqf Property Management. What is the full form of UMEED?

options.text: Unified Management, Empowerment, Efficiency, and Development
Unified Waqf Management, Empowerment, Efficiency, and Development
Universal Management, Empowerment, Efficiency, and Development
Unified Muslim Empowerment, Education, and Development

solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Unified Waqf Management, Empowerment, Efficiency, and Development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Minister Kiren Rijiju launches UMEED Central Portal to modernize Waqf Property Management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Union Minister Kiren Rijiju** launched the **UMEED Central Portal** in New Delhi to modernize the management of **Waqf properties** across India.

 
 
• 
 
The portal is named after the **Unified Waqf Management, Empowerment, Efficiency, and Development Act, 1995**.

 
 
• 
 
It is a **centralized digital platform** allowing real-time uploading, verification, and monitoring of Waqf properties.

 
 
• 
 
The portal aims to increase **transparency, accountability, and public participation** in Waqf asset administration.

 
 
• 
 
Features include a **digital inventory with geo-tagging**, an **online grievance redressal system**, and **real-time monitoring** of leasing and usage.

 
 
• 
 
It integrates with **GIS mapping** and **e-Governance tools** to improve management and offers **public access to verified records** to build trust and engagement.
